package.name: Haptic Feedback
package.description: Analyzes narrative content and controls every supported action and pattern on connected intimate toys in real time. Requires Intiface Central running locally; connect your toy there first. Add as both a Command and an Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Commands/Misc Agents for Conversation, Roleplay, and Game modes.
